description_en: Leadership Development Scheme for Minority Women providing training on women empowerment, government systems, life skills, digital literacy, and basic legal rights.
description_hi: अल्पसंख्यक महिलाओं के लिए नेतृत्व विकास योजना जो महिला सशक्तिकरण, सरकारी प्रणालियों, जीवन कौशल, डिजिटल साक्षरता और कानूनी अधिकारों पर प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करती है।
benefits_en: Free 6-day non-residential or residential leadership training, stipend allowance, and post-training handholding support.
benefits_hi: निःशुल्क 6 दिवसीय नेतृत्व प्रशिक्षण, दैनिक भत्ता एवं प्रशिक्षण उपरांत मार्गदर्शन।
eligibility_criteria: Minority women (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain) aged 18 to 65 years with annual family income below Rs 2.50 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

description_en: Integrated Education and Livelihood Initiative providing formal education certification (Class 8th or 10th through NIOS) along with market-driven skill development for minority dropouts.
description_hi: अल्पसंख्यक स्कूल ड्रॉपआउट युवाओं के लिए एनआईओएस के माध्यम से कक्षा 8 या 10 की औपचारिक शिक्षा और बाजार-उन्मुख कौशल विकास कार्यक्रम।
benefits_en: Free education bridge course, NIOS certification, vocational training, monthly stipend of Rs 1,000-1,500, and placement assistance.
benefits_hi: निःशुल्क शिक्षा, एनआईओएस प्रमाणन, व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण, मासिक छात्रवृत्ति और रोजगार सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: Minority youth aged 17 to 35 years who are school dropouts or studied in Madrasas.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

title_en: Seekho Aur Kamao (Learn and Earn) Scheme
description_en: Skill development initiative for minority youth aimed at upgrading skills in modern trades as well as preserving traditional arts and crafts with minimum 75% guaranteed placement.
description_hi: अल्पसंख्यक युवाओं के लिए आधुनिक और पारंपरिक व्यवसायों में कौशल विकास योजना, जिसमें न्यूनतम 75% प्लेसमेंट सहायता दी जाती है।
benefits_en: 100% government-funded skill training compliant with National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF), monthly stipend, and job placement.
benefits_hi: 100% निःशुल्क एनएसक्यूएफ कौशल प्रशिक्षण, मासिक वजीफा एवं रोजगार सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: Minority youth aged 14 to 35 years having minimum 5th class educational qualification.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

description_en: National scholarship scheme exclusively for meritorious girls belonging to notified minority communities studying in Classes IX to XII.
description_hi: अधिसूचित अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों की कक्षा 9 से 12 में पढ़ने वाली मेधावी छात्राओं के लिए विशेष छात्रवृत्ति।
benefits_en: Financial scholarship of Rs 5,000 for Class IX and X, and Rs 6,000 for Class XI and XII transferred directly via DBT.
benefits_hi: कक्षा 9 और 10 के लिए ₹5,000 तथा कक्षा 11 और 12 के लिए ₹6,000 की प्रत्यक्ष बैंक सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: Minority girl students studying in Classes 9 to 12 with at least 50% marks in previous examination and family income below Rs 2 Lakh per annum.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

description_en: Central sector scheme of interest subsidy on educational loans for overseas studies in Master's, M.Phil, and Ph.D. levels for meritorious minority students.
description_hi: विदेशों में उच्च शिक्षा (मास्टर्स, एम.फिल, पीएचडी) हेतु शिक्षा ऋण पर शत-प्रतिशत ब्याज सब्सिडी योजना।
benefits_en: 100% interest subsidy reimbursed by the government during the moratorium period on educational bank loans.
benefits_hi: शिक्षा ऋण अधिस्थगन (मोरेटोरियम) अवधि के दौरान पूरे ब्याज का सरकार द्वारा भुगतान।
eligibility_criteria: Minority students pursuing Masters or Ph.D. abroad with total family income not exceeding Rs 6 Lakh per annum.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

title_en: USTTAD (Upgrading Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts for Development)
description_en: Capacity building and skill enhancement scheme for traditional master craftsmen and artisans belonging to minority communities to build global market linkages.
description_hi: अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों के पारंपरिक कारीगरों एवं शिल्पकारों के कौशल उन्नयन और वैश्विक बाजार से जोड़ने की योजना।
benefits_en: Master trainer certification, design development grants, exhibition subsidies, and Hunar Haat platform access.
benefits_hi: मास्टर ट्रेनर प्रमाणन, डिज़ाइन विकास अनुदान, और हुनर हाट में निःशुल्क स्टॉल।
eligibility_criteria: Master craftsmen, artisans, and youth belonging to minority communities practicing hereditary arts.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

description_en: Area development program addressing infrastructure deficits in identified Minority Concentration Areas (MCAs) by constructing schools, hostels, ITIs, healthcare centers, and drinking water facilities.
description_hi: अल्पसंख्यक बहुल क्षेत्रों में स्कूल, छात्रावास, आईटीआई, अस्पताल और पेयजल जैसी बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं का निर्माण।
benefits_en: Community development infrastructure, smart classrooms, health clinics, and residential schools in minority pockets.
benefits_hi: सामुदायिक अवसंरचना, स्मार्ट क्लासरूम, स्वास्थ्य केंद्र और आवासीय विद्यालय।
eligibility_criteria: Residents living in identified Minority Concentration Blocks, Towns, and District Headquarters across India.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

title_en: NMDFC Term Loan & Micro Finance Scheme
title_hi: एनएमडीएफसी मियादी ऋण एवं सूक्ष्म वित्त योजना
description_en: Concessional credit scheme providing low-interest loans for minority entrepreneurs, small shopkeepers, artisans, and self-help groups to start income-generating enterprises.
description_hi: अल्पसंख्यक उद्यमियों, छोटे दुकानदारों, कारीगरों और स्वयं सहायता समूहों को कम ब्याज दर पर व्यवसायिक ऋण।
benefits_en: Term loans up to Rs 20 Lakh at concessional interest rate of 6% to 8% per annum through State Channelizing Agencies.
benefits_hi: ₹20 लाख तक का टर्म लोन मात्र 6% से 8% वार्षिक रियायती ब्याज दर पर।
eligibility_criteria: Citizens belonging to notified minority communities with annual household income up to Rs 3 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

description_en: Unique central initiative aimed at reversing the population decline of the Parsi Zoroastrian community in India through medical assistance, advocacy, and childcare financial support.
description_hi: पारसी समुदाय की घटती जनसंख्या को रोकने के लिए चिकित्सा सहायता, प्रजनन उपचार और बाल सहायता योजना।
benefits_en: Financial assistance up to Rs 8 Lakh per conception attempt for IVF and advanced fertility treatments, plus Rs 4,000/month per child assistance.
benefits_hi: प्रजनन उपचार हेतु प्रति प्रयास ₹8 लाख तक की सहायता एवं ₹4,000 प्रति माह बाल सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: Parsi couples holding valid marriage certificate and Parsi community verification.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

title_en: Gharib Nawaz Employment Scheme for Minorities
description_en: Employment-linked skill training scheme designed for youth belonging to minority communities to empower them with industry-certified technical skills.
description_hi: अल्पसंख्यक युवाओं को रोजगार-उन्मुख व्यावसायिक और तकनीकी प्रशिक्षण देने की योजना।
benefits_en: Free 3 to 6 months short-term certified courses with placement tie-ups and post-placement financial assistance of Rs 2,000/month.
benefits_hi: निःशुल्क 3 से 6 महीने का कौशल पाठ्यक्रम और ₹2,000 प्रतिमाह पोस्ट-प्लेसमेंट सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: Minority youth aged 18 to 35 years seeking technical livelihoods.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs

title_en: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Candidates
title_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के लिए राष्ट्रीय विदेशी छात्रवृत्ति
description_en: Flagship scholarship enabling meritorious low-income Scheduled Caste students to pursue Master's and Ph.D. degrees in top QS-ranked world universities abroad.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के मेधावी छात्रों को विदेशों के शीर्ष विश्वविद्यालयों में मास्टर्स और पीएचडी करने के लिए पूर्ण छात्रवृत्ति।
benefits_en: 100% tuition fee coverage, annual maintenance allowance of $15,400 (USA) or £9,900 (UK), return airfare, contingency allowance, and medical insurance.
benefits_hi: 100% ट्यूशन फीस, $15,400 या £9,900 वार्षिक रखरखाव भत्ता, हवाई किराया एवं वीजा शुल्क।
eligibility_criteria: SC candidates who have scored minimum 60% marks in qualifying degree with annual family income not exceeding Rs 8 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

title_en: SHREYAS Scheme for SC and OBC Students
description_en: Scheme for Higher Education Youth in Apprenticeship and Skills providing full financial support to SC and OBC students studying in premier institutions like IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, and NITs.
description_hi: आईआईटी, आईआईएम, एम्स और एनआईटी जैसे शीर्ष राष्ट्रीय संस्थानों में पढ़ने वाले एससी/ओबीसी छात्रों के लिए पूर्ण वित्तीय सहायता।
benefits_en: Full tuition fees up to Rs 2 Lakh per annum, non-refundable charges, living expenses of Rs 3,000/month, and computer allowance of Rs 45,000.
benefits_hi: पूर्ण ट्यूशन फीस, ₹3,000 प्रति माह निर्वाह भत्ता तथा ₹45,000 लैपटॉप/कंप्यूटर अनुदान।
eligibility_criteria: SC and OBC students admitted to notified premier higher educational institutions with family income up to Rs 8 Lakh/year.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

title_en: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
title_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के लिए वेंचर कैपिटल फंड (VCF-SC)
description_en: Dedicated sovereign fund to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes by providing equity funding and concessional venture loans for scalable tech, manufacturing, and service businesses.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के उद्यमियों द्वारा स्थापित नए व्यावसायिक उपक्रमों को इक्विटी निवेश और रियायती ऋण सहायता।
benefits_en: Financial assistance ranging from Rs 20 Lakh up to Rs 15 Crore per enterprise with subsidized interest rate of 4% for women/divyang and 8% for others.
benefits_hi: ₹20 लाख से ₹15 करोड़ तक की पूंजी सहायता मात्र 4% से 8% ब्याज दर पर।
eligibility_criteria: SC-promoted private limited companies or LLPs with minimum 51% shareholding by SC promoters for at least 12 months.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

title_en: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes (CEGSSC)
title_hi: अनुसूचित जातियों के लिए ऋण संवर्धन गारंटी योजना
description_en: Credit enhancement guarantee facility that encourages public and private sector banks to deliver term loans and working capital to SC entrepreneurs without demanding collateral.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के उद्यमियों को बिना किसी अतिरिक्त कोलैटरल (संपार्श्विक) के बैंकों से आसान ऋण उपलब्ध कराने की गारंटी योजना।
benefits_en: 100% credit guarantee cover for business loans from Rs 15 Lakh to Rs 5 Crore availed from commercial banks.
benefits_hi: ₹15 लाख से ₹5 करोड़ तक के बैंक ऋणों पर 100% सरकारी गारंटी कवरेज।
eligibility_criteria: Registered SC enterprises and registered entrepreneurs having valid caste certificate and bank loan approval.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

description_en: National action plan offering competency-based skill training, upskilling, re-skilling, and entrepreneurship development for marginalized groups including SCs, OBCs, EBCs, and Sanitation Workers.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति, पिछड़ा वर्ग और सफाई कर्मचारियों के लिए निःशुल्क उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला कौशल और उद्यमिता प्रशिक्षण।
benefits_en: 100% free skill training in NSQF-aligned courses, wage compensation stipend of Rs 1,000 to 1,500/month, and post-training toolkit.
benefits_hi: निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण, ₹1,000-₹1,500 प्रति माह वजीफा और निःशुल्क टूलकिट।
eligibility_criteria: Candidates belonging to SC, OBC (income < Rs 3 Lakh), EBC (income < Rs 1 Lakh), DNT, or Safai Karamchari families aged 18 to 45 years.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

title_en: PM-AJAY (Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana)
description_en: Integrated central scheme merging SCA to SCSP, PMAGY, and Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana to reduce poverty, provide livelihood grants, and build Adarsh Gram infrastructure in SC majority villages.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति बाहुल्य गांवों में आदर्श ग्राम विकास, कौशल केंद्र, छात्रावास और आजीविका अनुदान उपलब्ध कराने की समेकित योजना।
benefits_en: Direct livelihood capital subsidy up to Rs 50,000 per beneficiary, hostel facilities, and village infrastructure grants up to Rs 20 Lakh.
benefits_hi: प्रति लाभार्थी ₹50,000 तक की आजीविका सब्सिडी एवं गांव हेतु ₹20 लाख का विकास अनुदान।
eligibility_criteria: SC individuals and families below the poverty line or living in notified SC-majority villages (SC population > 50%).
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

description_en: Market-linked tribal enterprise initiative establishing Van Dhan Vikas Kendras for minor forest produce value addition, packaging, and brand building to boost forest gatherer incomes.
description_hi: जनजातीय वन उपज संग्राहकों के लिए वन धन केंद्रों की स्थापना, प्रसंस्करण और विपणन द्वारा आय बढ़ाने की योजना।
benefits_en: 100% government capital grant of Rs 15 Lakh per Van Dhan Kendra (300 tribal members), value addition equipment, and Tribes India marketing access.
benefits_hi: प्रति वन धन केंद्र ₹15 लाख का पूंजीगत अनुदान, आधुनिक प्रसंस्करण उपकरण और ट्राइब्स इंडिया मार्केट लिंकेज।
eligibility_criteria: Tribal minor forest produce gatherers and forest-dwelling Scheduled Tribe SHG members.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs

description_en: Exclusive concessional micro-credit scheme for Scheduled Tribe women entrepreneurs to start agriculture, dairy, handicrafts, tailoring, or petty shop enterprises.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जनजाति की महिला उद्यमियों को आत्मनिर्भर बनाने हेतु अति-रियायती ब्याज दर पर ऋण योजना।
benefits_en: Term loans up to Rs 2 Lakh per beneficiary at an interest rate of only 4% per annum with repayment over 5 to 10 years.
benefits_hi: ₹2,00,000 तक का आसान व्यापार ऋण मात्र 4% वार्षिक ब्याज दर पर।
eligibility_criteria: ST women aged 18 to 65 years whose annual family income is up to Rs 3 Lakh in rural or urban areas.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs

description_en: Fully funded CBSE-affiliated residential schools providing quality secondary and senior secondary education, modern science labs, smart boards, sports, and nutritious meals to remote tribal students.
description_hi: दूरदराज के जनजातीय क्षेत्रों के छात्रों को कक्षा 6 से 12 तक निःशुल्क आवासीय सीबीएसई शिक्षा, भोजन, वर्दी और पुस्तकें।
benefits_en: 100% free residential education, boarding, lodging, uniform, books, medical care, and competitive exam coaching.
benefits_hi: 100% निःशुल्क स्कूली शिक्षा, हॉस्टल, भोजन, पुस्तकें और प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं की कोचिंग।
eligibility_criteria: Scheduled Tribe (ST) boys and girls admitted in Class VI through state-level EMRS entrance examinations.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs

description_en: Targeted mission to saturate Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) habitations with basic facilities such as pucca housing, clean drinking water, electricity, road connectivity, and sustainable livelihoods.
description_hi: विशेष रूप से कमजोर जनजातीय समूहों (PVTG) के बस्तियों में पक्के मकान, स्वच्छ पेयजल, सड़क और आजीविका की व्यापक सुविधा।
benefits_en: Free pucca housing under PMAY-G, community water filter units, dedicated solar electrification, and 100% subsidized forest toolkits.
benefits_hi: निःशुल्क पक्का आवास, सोलर बिजली, पाइप पेयजल और आजीविका सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: Households belonging to the 75 notified Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) across 18 states and UTs.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs

title_en: NBCFDC New Swarnima Scheme for OBC Women
description_en: Term loan scheme aimed at inculcating the spirit of self-reliance among women belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBCs) for establishing micro-enterprises.
description_hi: अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (OBC) की महिलाओं को स्वरोजगार और छोटे उद्योग शुरू करने के लिए कम ब्याज दर पर ऋण सहायता।
benefits_en: Term loan up to Rs 2 Lakh at an ultra-low interest rate of 5% per annum with 95% project cost funded.
benefits_hi: ₹2,00,000 तक का लोन मात्र 5% वार्षिक ब्याज दर पर।
eligibility_criteria: Women aged between 18 and 55 years belonging to backward classes with annual family income up to Rs 3 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

description_en: Major credit-linked subsidy scheme to generate sustainable self-employment opportunities in rural and urban areas by setting up micro-enterprises in manufacturing and services.
description_hi: विनिर्माण और सेवा क्षेत्र में नए सूक्ष्म उद्योग स्थापित करने के लिए सरकार द्वारा 15% से 35% तक की बैंक सब्सिडी योजना।
benefits_en: Bank project loans up to Rs 50 Lakh (Manufacturing) and Rs 20 Lakh (Services) with 25% to 35% direct government capital subsidy (margin money).
benefits_hi: ₹50 लाख तक का बैंक लोन तथा 25% से 35% तक का सरकारी अनुदान (सब्सिडी)।
eligibility_criteria: Any individual above 18 years of age with minimum 8th pass qualification for projects above Rs 10 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

title_en: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
title_hi: सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यमों के लिए क्रेडिट गारंटी फंड (CGTMSE)
description_en: Flagship collateral-free bank loan guarantee scheme that enables first-generation entrepreneurs and MSMEs to secure business loans without third-party guarantees or property mortgages.
description_hi: एमएसएमई और नए उद्यमियों को बिना किसी प्रॉपर्टी गिरवी रखे या थर्ड पार्टी गारंटी के बैंकों से सुरक्षित बिजनेस लोन।
benefits_en: Collateral-free term loans and working capital up to Rs 5 Crore with government guarantee coverage up to 85%.
benefits_hi: ₹5 करोड़ तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त (बिना गारंटी) ऋण, जिसमें 85% तक सरकारी गारंटी शामिल है।
eligibility_criteria: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in manufacturing and service sectors.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

title_en: RAMP Scheme (Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance)
description_en: World Bank assisted national scheme to strengthen MSME governance, improve market access, resolve delayed payments, and accelerate technological upgrades.
description_hi: एमएसएमई क्षेत्र की कार्यक्षमता बढ़ाने, बाजार पहुंच में सुधार और विलंबित भुगतानों के समाधान के लिए विश्व बैंक समर्थित कार्यक्रम।
benefits_en: Direct technical assistance, access to credit facilitation portals, international trade linkage, and green transition grants.
benefits_hi: तकनीकी उन्नयन, व्यापार लिंकेज और हरित बदलाव हेतु सरकारी अनुदान।
eligibility_criteria: Registered MSMEs holding valid Udyam Registration Certificate.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

title_hi: एमएसएमई जेड प्रमाणन योजना (Zero Defect Zero Effect)
description_en: Scheme encouraging manufacturing MSMEs to adopt Zero Defect Zero Effect practices to manufacture world-class quality goods with minimum environmental pollution.
description_hi: पर्यावरण अनुकूल और शून्य दोष गुणवत्ता वाले विनिर्माण को बढ़ावा देने के लिए जेड प्रमाणन पर 80% तक सब्सिडी।
benefits_en: Up to 80% financial subsidy on ZED Certification fees (Bronze, Silver, Gold), plus Rs 5 Lakh technology upgrade grant and Rs 10 Lakh testing subsidy.
benefits_hi: प्रमाणन शुल्क पर 80% तक की छूट तथा ₹5 लाख का तकनीक उन्नयन अनुदान।
eligibility_criteria: Manufacturing MSMEs with valid Udyam Registration.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

description_en: Central seed funding scheme providing financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization.
description_hi: शुरुआती चरण के इनोवेटिव स्टार्टअप्स को प्रोटोटाइप, उत्पाद परीक्षण और बाजार में लॉन्च करने के लिए सीड ग्रांट।
benefits_en: Up to Rs 20 Lakh grant for validation of Proof of Concept & Prototype, and up to Rs 50 Lakh debt/convertible debenture for market launch.
benefits_hi: प्रोटोटाइप विकास हेतु ₹20 लाख तक का अनुदान एवं बाजार में लॉन्च हेतु ₹50 लाख तक का निवेश।
eligibility_criteria: DPIIT-recognized startups incorporated within 2 years with innovative business ideas leveraging technology.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry

description_en: Cluster development program to organize traditional artisans and craftspersons into sustainable clusters, establishing Common Facility Centers (CFCs) and modern product designs.
description_hi: पारंपरिक कारीगरों और हस्तशिल्पकारों के समूहों को आधुनिक उपकरण और कॉमन फैसिलिटी सेंटर उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।
benefits_en: Government grant up to Rs 2.5 Crore for Regular Clusters (up to 500 artisans) and up to Rs 5 Crore for Major Clusters.
benefits_hi: पारंपरिक क्लस्टरों के बुनियादी ढांचे और मशीनरी हेतु ₹2.5 करोड़ से ₹5 करोड़ तक का 100% अनुदान।
eligibility_criteria: Non-Government Organizations (NGOs), institutions, and artisan cooperatives representing at least 250 local craftspeople.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

title_hi: स्टार्टअप्स के लिए क्रेडिट गारंटी योजना (CGSS)
description_en: Sovereign credit guarantee mechanism ensuring collateral-free venture debt and term loans to DPIIT-recognized startups from commercial banks and NBFCs.
description_hi: डीपीआईआईटी-मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप्स को बिना किसी संपत्ति गारंटी के ₹10 करोड़ तक का वेंचर डेट उपलब्ध कराना।
benefits_en: Credit guarantee coverage up to Rs 10 Crore per startup without tangible collateral or promoter personal guarantees.
benefits_hi: ₹10 करोड़ तक के स्टार्टअप बैंक लोन पर केंद्र सरकार की गारंटी।
eligibility_criteria: DPIIT-recognized startups that have demonstrated scalable revenue or secured institutional venture funding.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry

description_en: Ministry of Electronics & IT initiative to scale early-stage software tech startups through accelerator mentorship, customer connects, and matching co-investments.
description_hi: आईटी और सॉफ्टवेयर स्टार्टअप्स को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए सरकारी मेंटरशिप और मैचिंग फंडिंग सहायता।
benefits_en: Matching equity funding up to Rs 40 Lakh per startup along with 6-month intensive accelerator bootcamp and corporate access.
benefits_hi: प्रति स्टार्टअप ₹40 लाख तक की मैचिंग इक्विटी फंडिंग और ग्लोबल मेंटरशिप।
eligibility_criteria: Indian software product startups in FinTech, HealthTech, EdTech, AgriTech, or AI ready for market acceleration.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

description_en: Financing facility for building post-harvest management infrastructure such as cold storages, warehouses, silos, grading units, and primary processing centers.
description_hi: कोल्ड स्टोरेज, वेयरहाउस, सॉर्टिंग-ग्रेडिंग यूनिट और प्राथमिक प्रसंस्करण केंद्र बनाने हेतु कम ब्याज पर बैंक ऋण।
benefits_en: 3% per annum interest subvention on bank loans up to Rs 2 Crore for a maximum period of 7 years, plus CGTMSE fee coverage.
benefits_hi: ₹2 करोड़ तक के बैंक ऋण पर 3% वार्षिक ब्याज छूट और क्रेडिट गारंटी।
eligibility_criteria: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, Agri-entrepreneurs, and Startups setting up post-harvest agricultural infrastructure.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

title_en: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
title_hi: पीएम सूक्ष्म खाद्य उद्योग उन्नयन योजना (PMFME)
description_en: Centrally sponsored scheme promoting One District One Product (ODOP) micro food processors with capital subsidy, brand development, and quality certifications.
description_hi: अचार, पापड़, तेल, मसाला, जूस जैसे सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों को आधुनिक बनाने हेतु 35% पूंजीगत सब्सिडी।
benefits_en: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to Rs 10 Lakh for individual units, Rs 40,000 seed capital per SHG member, and marketing support.
benefits_hi: मशीनरी पर 35% सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹10 लाख) एवं एसएचजी सदस्यों को ₹40,000 सीड कैपिटल।
eligibility_criteria: Existing and new micro food processing entrepreneurs, FPOs, and Self Help Groups.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries

description_en: Financial assistance program enabling small and marginal farmers to purchase modern farm machinery, tractors, power tillers, rotavators, and laser land levelers.
description_hi: छोटे और सीमांत किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, पावर टिलर, रीपर और आधुनिक कृषि यंत्र खरीदने हेतु 40% से 50% सरकारी सब्सिडी।
benefits_en: 40% to 50% direct subsidy on purchase of verified agricultural machinery and up to 80% subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs).
benefits_hi: कृषि यंत्रों की खरीद पर 40% से 50% सीधी छूट (सब्सिडी) एवं कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर हेतु 80% सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: All farmers with priority for Small, Marginal, Women, SC, and ST farmers having Aadhaar and land records.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

description_en: National mission promoting chemical-free organic farming through cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) organic certification.
description_hi: जैविक खेती को बढ़ावा देने के लिए किसानों के क्लस्टरों को ₹50,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर की वित्तीय और तकनीकी सहायता।
benefits_en: Financial assistance of Rs 50,000 per hectare for 3 years, of which Rs 31,000 is given directly for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides).
benefits_hi: प्रति हेक्टेयर ₹50,000 की सहायता (₹31,000 सीधे जैविक खाद, बीज व कीटनाशक हेतु)।
eligibility_criteria: Farmers willing to form clusters of 20 or more farmers holding contiguous agricultural land.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

description_en: Holistic fisheries development program covering aquaculture pond construction, motorized fishing boats, biofloc systems, cages, cold chain, and fish retail kiosks.
description_hi: मछली पालन तालाब निर्माण, मोटर चालित नाव, बायोफ्लॉक तकनीक और कोल्ड चेन स्थापित करने के लिए 40% से 60% सब्सिडी।
benefits_en: 40% government subsidy for General category and 60% subsidy for Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries on project costs up to Rs 50 Lakh.
benefits_hi: परियोजना लागत पर 40% से 60% तक सरकारी अनुदान (सब्सिडी)।
eligibility_criteria: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, and entrepreneurs engaged in inland or marine fisheries.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

description_en: National initiative for genetic upgradation of indigenous bovine breeds, artificial insemination, and financial assistance for setting up breed multiplication farms.
description_hi: देशी गायों और भैंसों की नस्ल सुधार, कृत्रिम गर्भाधान और डेयरी फार्म स्थापना पर 50% पूंजीगत सब्सिडी।
benefits_en: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs 2 Crore for establishing high-yielding breed multiplication dairy farms.
benefits_hi: नस्ल सुधार डेयरी फार्म स्थापित करने के लिए 50% सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹2 करोड़)।
eligibility_criteria: Dairy farmers, entrepreneurs, and cooperatives having land and basic dairy management experience.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

title_hi: राष्ट्रीय मधुमक्खी पालन एवं शहद मिशन (NBHM)
description_en: Mission for promoting the 'Sweet Revolution' through scientific beekeeping, setting up custom hives, bee breeding centers, and state-of-the-art honey testing laboratories.
description_hi: वैज्ञानिक मधुमक्खी पालन, हनी बॉक्स, निष्कर्षण उपकरण और शहद प्रसंस्करण केंद्र स्थापना हेतु सरकारी अनुदान।
benefits_en: Up to 80% subsidy for SC/ST and Women beekeepers on beehives and equipment, and up to Rs 30 Lakh subsidy for honey processing units.
benefits_hi: मधुमक्खी बक्से व उपकरणों पर 80% तक सब्सिडी और शहद प्रसंस्करण इकाइयों हेतु ₹30 लाख तक अनुदान।
eligibility_criteria: Farmers, landless rural workers, SHGs, and beekeeping cooperatives.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

description_en: New-age flagship skilling initiative offering free industry-aligned training in emerging technical skills such as AI, Robotics, Mechatronics, 3D Printing, Drones, and Green Hydrogen.
description_hi: एआई, रोबोटिक्स, 3डी प्रिंटिंग, ड्रोन तकनीक और सोलर ऊर्जा जैसे नए जमाने के क्षेत्रों में निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण।
benefits_en: 100% free certified skill training, government assessment certificate, on-the-job training stipend, and direct job fairs.
benefits_hi: 100% निःशुल्क तकनीकी प्रशिक्षण, राष्ट्रीय प्रमाण पत्र, ऑन-द-जॉब वजीफा और रोजगार मेले।
eligibility_criteria: Indian youth aged 15 to 45 years seeking employment or technical skill upgrades.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

description_en: Central scheme empowering 15,000 Women Self Help Groups with agricultural drones, pilot certification, and equipment to provide rental drone fertilizer and pesticide spraying services to farmers.
description_hi: महिला स्वयं सहायता समूहों को कृषि ड्रोन, निःशुल्क ड्रोन पायलट प्रशिक्षण और उपकरण देकर ड्रोन दीदी बनाने की योजना।
benefits_en: 80% government grant up to Rs 8 Lakh per drone, 15-day certified drone pilot training, and sustainable rental earnings of Rs 15,000-25,000/month.
benefits_hi: ड्रोन खरीद पर 80% सरकारी अनुदान (अधिकतम ₹8 लाख) और निःशुल्क 15 दिवसीय पायलट ट्रेनिंग।
eligibility_criteria: Women aged 18 and above who are active members of Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM Self Help Groups.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

description_en: National mentorship scheme for young Indian authors to promote reading, writing, and book culture, and project Indian literature globally.
description_hi: 30 वर्ष से कम आयु के युवा लेखकों को मेंटरशिप और 6 महीने तक ₹50,000 प्रतिमाह की स्कॉलरशिप।
benefits_en: Comprehensive mentorship by eminent authors, publication of authored books by National Book Trust, and a consolidated scholarship of Rs 50,000 per month for 6 months (Total Rs 3 Lakh).
benefits_hi: नेशनल बुक ट्रस्ट द्वारा पुस्तक प्रकाशन और 6 माह तक ₹50,000 प्रति माह छात्रवृत्ति (कुल ₹3,00,000)।
eligibility_criteria: Indian authors under 30 years of age selected through nationwide All India Book Proposal Contest.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Education

description_en: Community vocational skill training scheme for illiterate, neo-literate, and school dropouts with special focus on rural women and marginalized youth.
description_hi: ग्रामीण महिलाओं, स्कूल ड्रॉपआउट्स और वंचित वर्ग के युवाओं के लिए स्थानीय स्तर पर निःशुल्क व्यावसायिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण।
benefits_en: Doorstep vocational training in tailoring, beauty care, mobile repair, electrical wiring, food processing, and free toolkits.
benefits_hi: सिलाई, ब्यूटी केयर, मोबाइल रिपेयरिंग, वायरिंग आदि में निःशुल्क प्रशिक्षण और प्रमाण पत्र।
eligibility_criteria: Persons aged 15 to 45 years who are school dropouts, rural women, or socio-economically weaker individuals.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

description_en: Flagship direct benefit cash transfer scheme by Government of Maharashtra providing unconditional monthly financial support to women from economically weaker families.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र सरकार द्वारा आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों की महिलाओं को ₹1,500 प्रति माह की प्रत्यक्ष बैंक सहायता।
benefits_en: Direct bank transfer of Rs 1,500 every month (Total Rs 18,000 per year) directly to the woman beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
benefits_hi: प्रति माह ₹1,500 (वार्षिक ₹18,000) सीधे महिला के बैंक खाते में डीबीटी द्वारा।
eligibility_criteria: Resident women of Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years whose annual family income is up to Rs 2.50 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Maharashtra

description_en: Welfare scheme by Government of Maharashtra providing one-time financial aid to senior citizens suffering from age-related physical disabilities to purchase assistive equipment.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को चश्मा, श्रवण यंत्र, व्हीलचेयर व सहायक उपकरण खरीदने हेतु ₹3,000 की एकमुश्त सहायता।
benefits_en: One-time direct bank transfer of Rs 3,000 into the senior citizen's bank account to purchase eyeglasses, hearing aids, walkers, and wheelchairs.
benefits_hi: सहायक उपकरण खरीदने हेतु ₹3,000 की एकमुश्त प्रत्यक्ष बैंक सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: Senior citizens of Maharashtra aged 65 years and above with family income not exceeding Rs 2 Lakh per annum.
nodal_ministry: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Maharashtra

title_en: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY - Maharashtra)
title_hi: महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जन आरोग्य योजना (MJPJAY)
description_en: Universal health insurance coverage scheme by Government of Maharashtra providing completely cashless hospitalization and surgeries in network government and private hospitals.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र के सभी परिवारों को नेटवर्क अस्पतालों में गंभीर बीमारियों के इलाज हेतु प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
benefits_en: Cashless hospitalization, surgeries, and diagnostics cover up to Rs 5 Lakh per family per year across 1,356 identified medical procedures.
benefits_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5,00,000 तक का पूर्णतः निःशुल्क (कैशलेस) इलाज।
eligibility_criteria: All valid ration card holders and domicile families residing in the state of Maharashtra.
nodal_ministry: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra

description_en: Conditional cash transfer program by Government of Uttar Pradesh to ensure education, health, and social security of girl children across 6 milestone stages from birth to graduation.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश में बालिका के जन्म से लेकर स्नातक में प्रवेश तक 6 चरणों में कुल ₹25,000 की वित्तीय सहायता।
benefits_en: Total financial grant of Rs 25,000 delivered in 6 milestone instalments directly into the girl child/parent bank account.
benefits_hi: बालिका के जन्म, टीकाकरण, कक्षा 1, 6, 9 और कॉलेज प्रवेश पर कुल ₹25,000 की आर्थिक मदद।
eligibility_criteria: Permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh with maximum 2 daughters in family and annual income up to Rs 3 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh

description_en: Free competitive exam coaching initiative by Government of Uttar Pradesh offering in-person classes, tablets, and mentorship by IAS/IPS officers for UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, NEET, and NDA.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के मेधावी युवाओं को यूपीएससी, यूपीपीएससी, जेईई, नीट और एनडीए की 100% निःशुल्क कोचिंग एवं निःशुल्क टैबलेट।
benefits_en: 100% free physical coaching at divisional headquarters, virtual library, study material, and free digital tablet.
benefits_hi: निःशुल्क प्रतियोगी परीक्षा कोचिंग, ई-लर्निंग सामग्री और चयनित छात्रों को फ्री टैबलेट।
eligibility_criteria: Domicile students of Uttar Pradesh preparing for competitive exams selected through state entrance test.
nodal_ministry: Social Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh

description_en: Self-employment credit initiative by Government of UP providing subsidized loans to educated unemployed youth for setting up micro industries and service enterprises.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को उद्योग लगाने हेतु ₹25 लाख तथा सेवा क्षेत्र हेतु ₹10 लाख का आसान ऋण एवं 25% सब्सिडी।
benefits_en: Project loans up to Rs 25 Lakh (Industry) and Rs 10 Lakh (Services) with 25% margin money subsidy (up to Rs 6.25 Lakh).
benefits_hi: ₹25 लाख तक का प्रोजेक्ट लोन तथा 25% (अधिकतम ₹6.25 लाख) की सरकारी सब्सिडी।
eligibility_criteria: Resident youth of Uttar Pradesh aged 18 to 40 years with minimum High School (10th pass) education.
nodal_ministry: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Uttar Pradesh

description_en: Pioneering financial empowerment initiative by Government of Karnataka delivering monthly cash assistance to woman heads of households to combat price rise and support household security.
description_hi: कर्नाटक सरकार द्वारा परिवार की महिला मुखिया को ₹2,000 प्रति माह की सीधी आर्थिक सहायता।
benefits_en: Direct cash transfer of Rs 2,000 every month (Total Rs 24,000 per year) directly credited to the beneficiary's DBT bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Woman identified as head of family in Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards of Karnataka (non-taxpayers).
nodal_ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Karnataka

description_en: Unemployment allowance and skill enhancement scheme by Government of Karnataka for unemployed graduates and diploma holders to support them while seeking jobs.
description_hi: कर्नाटक के बेरोजगार स्नातकों को ₹3,000 तथा डिप्लोमा धारकों को ₹1,500 प्रतिमाह बेरोजगारी भत्ता और निःशुल्क स्किलिंग।
benefits_en: Monthly financial allowance of Rs 3,000 for Degree Graduates and Rs 1,500 for Diploma holders for a period of up to 2 years.
benefits_hi: ग्रेजुएट को ₹3,000/माह तथा डिप्लोमा को ₹1,500/माह बेरोजगारी सहायता 2 साल तक।
eligibility_criteria: Domicile graduates and diploma holders of Karnataka who passed out in recent academic year and remained unemployed for 6 months.
nodal_ministry: Department of Skill Development and Livelihood, Karnataka

description_en: Universal energy welfare scheme by Government of Karnataka providing free domestic electricity up to 200 units per month to all residential households.
description_hi: कर्नाटक के सभी घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को प्रति माह 200 यूनिट तक निःशुल्क बिजली।
benefits_en: Zero electricity bill for domestic consumption up to 200 units per month based on average annual usage entitlement.
benefits_hi: 200 यूनिट तक घरेलू बिजली की खपत पर शून्य बिजली बिल।
eligibility_criteria: All domestic residential electricity connections in the state of Karnataka registered on Seva Sindhu.
nodal_ministry: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka

description_en: Historic universal basic income scheme by Government of Tamil Nadu providing monthly dignity honorarium to women heads of families recognizing their unpaid household labor.
description_hi: तमिलनाडु सरकार द्वारा परिवार की महिला मुखिया को ₹1,000 प्रति माह की मूल आय सहायता।
benefits_en: Direct bank transfer of Rs 1,000 every month directly to the woman beneficiary's bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Women heads of family aged 21 years and above residing in Tamil Nadu with family annual income below Rs 2.50 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Special Programme Implementation Department, Tamil Nadu

description_en: Higher education incentive scheme by Government of Tamil Nadu for female students who completed Classes VI to XII in government schools to prevent female student dropout.
description_hi: सरकारी स्कूल से पढ़ी छात्राओं को कॉलेज की पढ़ाई पूरी करने हेतु ₹1,000 प्रति माह की छात्रवृत्ति।
benefits_en: Monthly financial scholarship of Rs 1,000 directly credited into the student's bank account until successful completion of graduation or diploma.
benefits_hi: स्नातक या डिप्लोमा पूरा होने तक ₹1,000 प्रति माह की सीधी सहायता।
eligibility_criteria: Girl students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu government schools pursuing undergraduate degree or diploma.
nodal_ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu

description_en: Empowerment scheme by Government of Madhya Pradesh delivering direct financial aid to married, widowed, and divorced women to foster economic independence and nutrition.
description_hi: मध्य प्रदेश की 21 से 60 वर्ष की विवाहित, विधवा और परित्यक्ता महिलाओं को ₹1,250 प्रति माह की सीधी बैंक सहायता।
benefits_en: Direct monthly bank transfer of Rs 1,250 (Rs 15,000 per year) directly credited into the woman's bank account.
benefits_hi: प्रति माह ₹1,250 (वार्षिक ₹15,000) सीधे महिला के आधार-लिंक्ड बैंक खाते में।
eligibility_criteria: Resident women of Madhya Pradesh aged 21 to 60 years whose family income is less than Rs 2.50 Lakh per year.
nodal_ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh

description_en: On-the-job training scheme by Government of Madhya Pradesh providing industrial skill internships across 700+ sectors with guaranteed monthly government stipends.
description_hi: मध्य प्रदेश के 18 से 29 वर्ष के युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक प्रशिक्षण के साथ ₹8,000 से ₹10,000 प्रति माह स्टाइपेंड।
benefits_en: Monthly stipend of Rs 8,000 (12th Pass), Rs 8,500 (ITI Pass), Rs 9,000 (Diploma), and Rs 10,000 (Graduates/Post-graduates) during 1-year training.
benefits_hi: शैक्षणिक योग्यता के अनुसार ₹8,000 से ₹10,000 प्रति माह स्टाइपेंड एवं एससीवीटी प्रमाणन।
eligibility_criteria: Youth residing in Madhya Pradesh aged 18 to 29 years holding 12th, ITI, Diploma, or Higher Degree.
nodal_ministry: Technical Education and Skill Development Department, Madhya Pradesh

description_en: Elite coaching assistance scheme by Government of Rajasthan providing completely free coaching in top reputed institutes for UPSC, RAS, IIT-JEE, NEET, CLAT, and CA.
description_hi: राजस्थान के आरक्षित और आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर छात्रों को शीर्ष संस्थानों में यूपीएससी, जेईई, नीट की 100% फ्री कोचिंग और ₹40,000 आवासीय भत्ता।
benefits_en: 100% tuition fees paid directly to coaching institutes plus Rs 40,000 annual boarding and lodging allowance for students studying outside their hometown.
benefits_hi: पूर्ण कोचिंग फीस का सरकार द्वारा भुगतान तथा गृह जिले से बाहर रहने पर ₹40,000 वार्षिक आवास भत्ता।
eligibility_criteria: Domicile students of Rajasthan belonging to SC, ST, OBC, MBC, EWS, and Minority categories with family income up to Rs 8 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Rajasthan

description_en: Flagship basic income support program by Government of West Bengal ensuring financial independence for female heads of families.
description_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल की सामान्य वर्ग की महिलाओं को ₹1,000 तथा एससी/एसटी वर्ग की महिलाओं को ₹1,200 प्रति माह की सीधी आर्थिक सहायता।
benefits_en: Direct monthly bank transfer of Rs 1,200 per month for SC/ST women and Rs 1,000 per month for General category women.
benefits_hi: एससी/एसटी महिलाओं को ₹1,200/माह तथा सामान्य महिलाओं को ₹1,000/माह बैंक खाते में।
eligibility_criteria: Resident women of West Bengal aged 25 to 60 years who are not in permanent government employment.
nodal_ministry: Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal

description_en: United Nations Public Service Award-winning conditional scholarship program by Government of West Bengal to improve the status and education of girls and prevent child marriage.
description_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल की छात्राओं को कक्षा 8 से 12 तक वार्षिक ₹1,000 छात्रवृत्ति और 18 वर्ष पूर्ण होने पर ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त सहायता।
benefits_en: Annual scholarship of Rs 1,000 (K1) for girls aged 13-18 in school, and a one-time grant of Rs 25,000 (K2) at age 18 if unmarried and enrolled in education.
benefits_hi: वार्षिक ₹1,000 छात्रवृत्ति एवं 18 वर्ष पर ₹25,000 का एकमुश्त कन्याश्री अनुदान।
eligibility_criteria: Unmarried girl students aged 13 to 19 years studying in recognized schools/colleges in West Bengal.
nodal_ministry: Women and Child Development Department, West Bengal

description_en: Comprehensive agricultural investment support scheme by Government of Andhra Pradesh delivering input subsidies to landholding and tenant farmers before sowing seasons.
description_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश के किसान परिवारों और काश्तकार किसानों को प्रति वर्ष ₹13,500 की सीधी कृषि इनपुट सहायता।
benefits_en: Financial assistance of Rs 13,500 per farmer family per year disbursed in 3 direct instalments for seeds, fertilizers, and farm inputs.
benefits_hi: प्रति वर्ष ₹13,500 की सहायता तीन किश्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में।
eligibility_criteria: Farmer families and eligible SC, ST, BC, Minority tenant farmers holding crop cultivator rights in Andhra Pradesh.
nodal_ministry: Department of Agriculture, Andhra Pradesh

description_en: Direct cash incentive by Government of Andhra Pradesh credited to the bank accounts of needy mothers to support their children's schooling from Class I to XII.
description_hi: कक्षा 1 से 12 तक बच्चों को स्कूल भेजने वाली माताओं को ₹15,000 प्रति वर्ष की प्रत्यक्ष आर्थिक सहायता।
benefits_en: Annual financial grant of Rs 15,000 credited directly to the mother's bank account ensuring 75% student school attendance.
benefits_hi: ₹15,000 वार्षिक सहायता सीधे माता के बैंक खाते में।
eligibility_criteria: Mothers from below poverty line (BPL) families in Andhra Pradesh whose children maintain at least 75% school attendance.
nodal_ministry: Department of School Education, Andhra Pradesh

description_en: First-of-its-kind direct investment support scheme by Government of Telangana providing per-acre cash support for procurement of agricultural inputs like seeds and fertilizers.
description_hi: तेलंगाना के किसानों को प्रति एकड़ प्रति सीजन ₹5,000 (वार्षिक ₹10,000 प्रति एकड़) की सीधी कृषि निवेश सहायता।
benefits_en: Direct bank transfer of Rs 5,000 per acre per season (Total Rs 10,000 per acre per year for Rabi and Kharif crops).
benefits_hi: ₹10,000 प्रति एकड़ प्रति वर्ष सीधे किसान के बैंक खाते में।
eligibility_criteria: Pattadar landholding farmers in Telangana holding digital Dharani passbooks.
nodal_ministry: Agriculture Department, Government of Telangana

description_en: Financial assistance program by Government of Telangana to prevent child marriage and assist economically disadvantaged families during the marriage of their daughters.
description_hi: तेलंगाना में एससी, एसटी, बीसी और अल्पसंख्यक वर्ग की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹1,00,116 की एकमुश्त आर्थिक सहायता।
benefits_en: One-time direct financial grant of Rs 1,00,116 transferred into the bride's mother's bank account.
benefits_hi: दुल्हन की माता के बैंक खाते में ₹1,00,116 की एकमुश्त सहायता राशि।
eligibility_criteria: Resident brides of Telangana aged 18 years and above belonging to SC, ST, BC, EBC, or Minority categories with family income up to Rs 2 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Scheduled Castes Development Department, Telangana

description_en: Flagship enterprise promotion initiative by Government of Bihar providing capital grants and interest-free loans to women entrepreneurs to establish manufacturing and service units.
description_hi: बिहार में महिलाओं को नया उद्योग लगाने हेतु ₹10 लाख की सहायता (₹5 लाख 100% माफ अनुदान एवं ₹5 लाख ब्याज-मुक्त ऋण)।
benefits_en: Total project assistance up to Rs 10 Lakh (50% grant up to Rs 5 Lakh is completely non-refundable, and remaining 50% is 100% interest-free loan repayable in 84 instalments).
benefits_hi: ₹5 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान तथा ₹5 लाख का ब्याज-मुक्त ऋण (0% ब्याज)।
eligibility_criteria: Women residing in Bihar aged 18 to 50 years with minimum 10+2 (Intermediate) or ITI/Polytechnic qualification.
nodal_ministry: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar

description_en: State government guaranteed educational financing scheme providing collateral-free education loans for higher education courses like B.Tech, MBBS, MBA, BCA, and Polytechnic.
description_hi: उच्च शिक्षा हेतु छात्रों को बिना किसी गारंटी के ₹4 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण मात्र 1% से 4% साधारण ब्याज पर।
benefits_en: Education loan up to Rs 4 Lakh with 100% state government guarantee at 1% interest rate for Girls, Transgender, and Divyangjan (4% for Boys).
benefits_hi: ₹4,00,000 तक का आसान शिक्षा ऋण (छात्राओं हेतु मात्र 1% ब्याज दर)।
eligibility_criteria: Permanent residents of Bihar aged up to 25 years who have passed 12th grade and secured admission in recognized higher education institutions.
nodal_ministry: Education Department, Government of Bihar

description_en: Educational incentive scheme by Government of Gujarat to encourage girl students from poor and middle-class families to opt for Science Stream in Higher Secondary (Classes 11 & 12).
description_hi: गुजरात में कक्षा 11 और 12 में विज्ञान (साइंस) संकाय चुनने वाली छात्राओं को 2 वर्षों में कुल ₹25,000 की छात्रवृत्ति।
benefits_en: Direct scholarship of Rs 10,000 in Class 11 and Rs 15,000 in Class 12 (Total Rs 25,000) transferred directly into the student's bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Girl students studying in Gujarat state government and grant-in-aid schools opting for Science stream with family income up to Rs 2 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Education Department, Government of Gujarat

description_en: Social security and care scheme by Government of Gujarat providing comprehensive financial assistance and free education to children who have lost both parents.
description_hi: अनाथ बच्चों के पालन-पोषण और शिक्षा हेतु 18 वर्ष की आयु तक ₹4,000 प्रति माह की सीधी वित्तीय सहायता।
benefits_en: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 4,000 per month per child until the age of 18 years, plus preference in government residential schools.
benefits_hi: ₹4,000 प्रति माह 18 वर्ष की आयु तक तथा कस्तूरबा गांधी बालिका विद्यालय/आवासीय विद्यालयों में प्राथमिकता।
eligibility_criteria: Children residing in Gujarat who have lost both biological parents or surviving parent.
nodal_ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat
